Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am43.model.cards.Card
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Event, TribeCard
public abstract class Card extends Object implements Serializable
Abstract class representing a generic card within the game. Outlines high-level shared properties such as eras, unique identifiers, and pickup behaviors.
